name: Anchor every intent to the prose
description: Each intent stores its quote with start and end offsets into the prose (the intent map). The quote is searched verbatim first, then ignoring case and runs of whitespace from a word boundary. The whole extraction is rejected with an ArtifactError listing every problem if any quote is not found; a beyond-proof intent has no reason or a reason is unknown; a decision has fewer than two options, a recommended index out of range or an unknown intent; a modify or remove names a use case that does not exist; an add does not reserve a new id and a new kebab-case slug; an add or modify has no after; a touched use case does not have exactly one resulting use case listing at least one intent; or an intent replaces a proof that does not exist or belongs to another use case.
